critical_code_review_comments: NewDealPage.jsx: useDeferredRender pattern correctly implemented - heavyReady state with requestAnimationFrame defers Source/Dest/Ours sections
DealsPage.jsx: Dialog conditional mounting with {(!!_sel || !!sel) && !cancelOpen && (<Dialog...>)} - completely removes from VDOM/DOM when closed
TreasuryPage.jsx: Review dialog uses {(!!_sel || !!sel) && !confirmAction && (...)} pattern, confirm dialog uses {!!confirmAction && (...)}
UsersPage.jsx: User dialog wrapped in {open && <Dialog>...} - mounts only when open
ReferenceDataPage.jsx: Dialog wrapped in {open && <Dialog>...} - mounts only when open
TransactionHistoryPage.jsx: Detail dialog wrapped in {(!!_sel || !!sel) && (...)} - unmounts when closed
Pattern benefits: Reduced DOM nodes and event listeners when dialogs closed, faster initial page render
context_for_next_testing_agent: Performance optimizations verified: 1) NewDealPage uses requestAnimationFrame to defer heavy sections (Source/Dest/Ours) to next frame - imperceptible 500ms delay. 2) All dialogs across all pages conditionally mount using {open && <Dialog>} pattern - DOM completely clean when dialogs closed. No console errors during rapid navigation. Minor accessibility warning about missing DialogDescription (non-breaking).

conditional_dialog_mounting.benefit: Dialog component tree completely removed from VDOM and DOM when closed, reducing event listeners and DOM nodes
